name: Queer LifeSpace
description: Sliding-scale therapy; groups from $20 and individual sessions from $30-$40
fullDescription: Queer LifeSpace provides low-cost, sliding-scale individual, couples, and group therapy for the LGBTQIA+ community, in person in San Francisco or by Zoom for California residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Individual therapy (sliding scale, starting at $30-$40 per session)
- Couples therapy (sliding scale, starting at $60 per session)
- Group therapy (starting at $20 per session), including gender spectrum, gay men's, queer women's, and QTBIPOC groups
- Queer and trans youth services
- Clinicians matched to your needs and lived experience
- In-person or Zoom sessions
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the client intake form on queerlifespace.org
2. A team member will follow up to screen and match you with a clinician
3. Set your fee with your clinician based on income
4. Must be a California resident
5. Email info@queerlifespace.org with questions about group openings
keywords: Queer LifeSpace, San Francisco, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, mental health, therapy, counseling, sliding scale, low-cost, group therapy, couples counseling, youth, telehealth
